sources.use: Official factual source; link and short paraphrase only. Full answer screenshot intentionally excluded.
supported_points: Payment notification alone does not establish a normal reservation if no reservation number exists.
Payment completed without a booking is described as automatically canceled within 2–3 business days.
If still not canceled after 3 business days, the booker should check payment approval information and contact ticket support or online inquiry.
The FAQ does not specify the card issuer’s final refund timing.

sources.use: Public menu, support phone/hours and inquiry entry screenshots.

editorial_note: Preparation details for inquiries and contacting support before an imminent performance are practical editorial advice, not promises of expedited cancellation/refund.
